title: Astronomers discover hot watery exoplanet destined to be swallowed by its star
hook: Astronomers discover hot watery exoplanet destined to be swallowed by its star

beats.caption: Astronomers discover hot watery exoplanet destined to be swallowed by its star
Three planets were found recently but one is doomed.
beats.narration: Three planets were discovered recently, but one of them is already doomed.

beats.caption: It is a watery world orbiting a star.
beats.narration: This new planet is almost entirely covered in water.

beats.caption: It orbits too close to the heat.
beats.detail: The star is pulling it in.
beats.narration: But it is orbiting so close to its star that it is in serious trouble.

beats.caption: The star will eventually devour the planet.
beats.narration: The star is going to swallow this planet whole.

beats.caption: It is a fatal path for this world.
beats.narration: It is a fatal path, and there is nowhere for the planet to hide.

beats.caption: We learn how stars destroy their planets.
beats.narration: Seeing this helps us understand how stars can destroy the planets around them.
